summary: The coffee-ship real-app rewrite fully satisfies the plan and task intent, and I independently verified every claim rather than trusting the FEAT/verification files. container/app.py is a genuine boto3 backend: DynamoDB put_item/get_item/scan, an SSM loyalty rate cached ~60s with fallback 10, a pure status_for (RECEIVED <10s / BREWING 10-25s / READY >=25s), POST /order + GET /order/{id} (and ?id=) + GET /orders, /health that stays 200 without AWS, SPA static serving with an intact path-traversal guard (I confirmed a raw ../../etc/passwd request returns the SPA index, not the file), APP_VERSION v3-realapp, a guarded boto3 import with lazy clients, and no in-memory fakes. boto3==1.34.162 is the only new dependency and the Dockerfile pip-installs it before copying app.py. The infra change is minimal: loyaltyParam.grantRead on the task role adds ssm:GetParameter on just that parameter ARN; cdk synth is clean (tsc --noEmit clean, synth exit 0) and the synthesized template shows ALB ingress is SourcePrefixListId-only (the single 0.0.0.0/0 is the ECS service SG default egress), CloudFront present, zero VPCs created, ECR keep-10, both EcsDeployAction stages, and the EventBridge Object Created rule all intact. The SPA polls GET /order/{id} to READY, renders the recent-10 table, uses same-origin relative calls, and keeps the theme. architecture.svg is rebuilt by build_diagram.py from 11 base64-embedded official AWS *_64.svg icons (regeneration is deterministic — no git drift), the top-level SVG matches, and README/runbook describe the real app. Region ap-southeast-1 is pinned, serverless app/** is untouched, and no live-AWS commands were run. Local verification passed: py_compile, 4/4 unit tests, SPA build, runtime smoke (/, /health v3-realapp, /nope.js 404, /spa/route 200, order endpoints 500 without AWS and the server stayed alive). No blocking or major concerns remain.
